trust_decision.summary: Whether the redirect_uri from the /authorize query (or PAR record) may be navigated to: it is checked against the client's registered callback URLs in the backend (getCallbackURL / ResolveAllowedCallbackURL), but the SPA's prompt=none error path redirectWithError navigates to the raw query value with only a javascript:/data: scheme check.

landing_point.why: The summary names the /authorize page and prompt=none; redirectWithError is the only navigation there that uses the unvalidated callbackURL from page data.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report is about a client-side redirect on the prompt=none error path; the CSP-header resolver in the embedded-frontend package and the backend Authorize service already validate redirect_uri, so a solver would argue the backend is correct and patch only the Svelte page.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate prompt=none error redirects (login_required, consent_required, interaction_required, with response_mode=fragment) must still reach a registered or default (first configured) callback URL, including when redirect_uri is omitted or loopback with any port; and the TOFU auto-registration of the first callback URL in getCallbackURL must stay only on the authenticated Authorize path, not on a new unauthenticated resolver.
